notes.title: Version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where in Case "Tender Tragedy" the wrong headline would be displayed after making decisions
- Fixed an issue where looking at the fruit wouldn't trigger the needed action to advance

notes.title: Version 1.1.4
notes.notes: - fixes a bug where all possible deductions and motives were unlocked at the start of case three. Unfortunately, all savegame-files where the third case was started on version 1.1.3. will continue having this bug. All other savegame-files are fine or will be fixed by starting the third case on version 1.1.4

notes.title: Version 1.1.3.
notes.notes:
- Various grammatical errors are fixed in German and Italian version
- Wrong headlines on the deduction board are fixed.
- Achievement "Nothing to see" is actually obtainable – just play the very end of the last case again.

notes.title: Second Livestream! Kickstarter Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]So Many Demo-Downloads![/h1]
The demo continues to be part of the great Steam Next Fest - it's the perfect moment to download the complete first case of Casebook 1899 - The Leipzig Murders. You'll be in good company!
Then head over to the Community page or the games Twitter page and let me know what you think about it!

[h1]Second Developer Live-Stream![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657396/a111491a88c1090ea871057e96b356910ab3633f.png[/img]
Since the first developer stream was - well, let's call it "not without room to improve" I decided to have a second developer stream THIS FRIDAY! This time it won't be plagued by technical problems and I'll have an eye on the chat so you can ask me your questions directly in the stream!
Be sure to tune in!

[h1]Kickstarter Update![/h1]
We just passed the halfway-mark for the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/casebook/casebook-1899-the-leipzig-murders]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. This means more than half the time has passed and you have only time until the end of the month to back it!
But we also have gotten half the money! Currently it's sitting at 54% - I'm sure we can do better than that! Head on over to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/casebook/casebook-1899-the-leipzig-murders]Kickstarter[/url] now!

notes.title: Casebook 1899 loves the Tux and Demo-Release-Date
notes.notes:
Good news, Linux-Lovers! 
[h3][b]Casebook 1899 - The Leipzig Murders[/b] will be coming to [b]Linux[/b] as well. [/h3]
And the best news is that it won't be tied to any stretch goals of the upcoming crowdfunding, it will happen just like that!
Of course the free demo will also come to Linux.

Speaking of... The date for the release of the demo is set as well!
[h3][b]You will be able to play the complete first case from May 31![/b][/h3]

To celebrate the start of the crowdfunding I will release the first case FOR FREE.

The demo will:
[list]
[*]be available for PC, Mac and Linux
[*]offer around 50 minutes of gameplay
[*]let you explore a German boomtown at the end of the 19th century
[*]be fully voiced in German
[*]offer subtitles in German and English
[*]get your "little grey cells" [b]really[/b] working
[/list]
Hope you will download the demo and be convinced to get involved in the crowdfunding that starts the same day!
